source_review.notes: Checked all fifteen primary references. CNCF and DORA platform guidance, Team Topologies interaction guidance, Google SRE engagement/lifecycle/on-call/overload/toil/incident/training guidance, and GOV.UK assisted-support guidance support the bounded current claims.

evidence: Reviewed demand-class, arrival, mean-effort, burst, reserved-load, skill-capacity, case-timestamp, recurrence and enabling-engagement notation.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation separates scalar demand, skill/coverage feasibility, response/restoration/resolution and independent enabling outcomes.

evidence: Executed the synthetic support-capacity audit and reproduced requests=12, route counts 4/2/3/2/1, weighted_demand=23, capacity=24, headroom=1 and gate=pass.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Effort totals 4+2+6+6+5=23 and leaves one declared unit; the text disclaims universal staffing interpretation.

evidence: Verified arrival-times-effort-times-burst plus reserved-load demand, per-skill/time capacity constraints, distinct case durations and enabling exit predicate.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The model correctly states scalar person-hours cannot compensate for missing skill, access or coverage.

evidence: Reviewed unstaffed channels, control-plane loss, VIP queue jumping, ambiguous ownership, time-zone/accessibility exclusion, correlated bursts, hero experts, hidden overtime, permanent embedding, unsafe automation, vendor delay, shadow channels, surveillance, re-identification and punitive handback.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Coverage spans product, operational, organizational, capacity, health, equity, privacy, security, vendor and lifecycle boundaries.

evidence: Traced contract, ownership, sustainability, enabling, safety/equity and learning invariants through self-service, triage, incidents, communities, office hours, engagements, overload, toil, vendors and handback.
invariant_checking.notes: The invariants prevent promise ambiguity, ownership capture, overload-by-overtime, permanent dependence, inaccessible urgency and closure-only optimization.

evidence: Verified two platforms with equal ticket reduction: one prevents defects through diagnostics while the other suppresses accessible intake and pushes users to abandonment/private workarounds.
proof_review.notes: Equal observed demand with different outcomes and accessibility correctly refutes ticket-volume reduction as sufficient support evidence.

evidence: The ticket-volume counterexample is explicitly labeled a proof sketch and states construction, consequence and stronger evidence.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No staffing ratio, engagement model, channel or capacity calculation is represented as a universal theorem.

evidence: The capacity audit is explicitly synthetic and disclaims universal staffing ratios; examples are scenarios; current guidance is retrieval-dated; no real support outcome is claimed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No real queue, incident, engagement, engineer-health, user-access or external-review result is presented as observed evidence.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed support promises, ownership, layered paths, self-service, diagnostics, intake, severity, incidents, communities, office hours, enabling entry/contracts/practice/exit, embedding, handback, demand/capacity, overload, toil, vendors, outcomes and privacy.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed implementability with catalog contracts, current on-call identities, task/error diagnostics, minimal intake, impact triage, independent incident paths, async accessibility, paired engagements, observed exit exercises, workload/headroom models, shedding, recurrence backlogs, vendor mapping and privacy controls.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified required order, one-page review, definitions and formulas, twelve-step mechanism, six invariants, bounded proof sketch, executable audit, eighteen trade-offs, thirty misconceptions, ten examples, ten connections, fifteen references, and five answered exercises.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
